parsed.note_claim: The passport image falsely attributed to Pam Bondi is AI-generated.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: there is no evidence the image authentically depicts an Israeli passport belonging to Bondi. It was generated with artificial intelligence and originated from a social media account that describes itself as satirical.
parsed.reason: The Snopes fact check directly states the passport image was AI-generated and falsely attributed to Bondi, and it also notes her Italian-American identity.
